He picked a fight with one NPC... and accidentally activated the entire street.
Downtown. Rush hour. Nobody looks up.
He blocked the crosswalk. Every time they moved... so did he.
People walked past. Nobody wanted a side quest.
One stranger said no. And that changed everything.
A taxi driver saw everything... and refused to move.
Suddenly, the street was paying attention.
One became two. Two became four.
And for the first time... he was the one outnumbered.
No fight. No damage. He just walked away.
They walked the stranger all the way to the sidewalk.
Sometimes, the whole street is on your team.
